title: Flux 3 Draft Enhance
description: FLUX.3 is Black Forest Labs' frontier audio/video model. Re-render a previously generated draft at full quality — same seed, same motion, no re-planning.

pricing.text: Your request will be charged at 0.29 $ per second of the enhanced video (full-quality 1080p render). Synchronized audio is included at no extra cost.

inputs.name: draft_cache_url
inputs.tooltip: URL or data URI of the encrypted draft cache bundle to enhance. Paste a link; leave empty to leave it out.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for the generated video. 0 is the strictest and 4 is the most permissive.
